question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Monotonous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Engrossing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Monotonous"** means something that is dull, tedious, and repetitious; lacking in variety and interest. (नीरस)

 
 
• **Example: **The monotonous routine of his job made him feel unmotivated.
 
 
 
• **"Engrossing"** refers to something that is absorbing all the attention or interest of someone; very interesting. (रोमांचक)
 
 
• **Example: **The novel was so engrossing that she couldn't put it down until she finished it.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Monotonous'** is **'Engrossing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Engrossing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Tiresome **(थकाऊ): Causing one to feel bored or annoyed.

 
 
• **Example:** The long, tiresome journey left everyone exhausted.
 
 
 
• **Tedious **(उबाऊ): Too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous.
 
 
• **Example: **The tedious process of filling out forms made everyone impatient.
 
 
 
• **Rational** (तार्किक): Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.
 
 
• **Example:** His rational explanation convinced everyone in the meeting.
